new.title: Sign in
new.organization_hint_html: The short name of your organization, such as acme.
new.already_signed_in: You are signed in. Sign in again to switch accounts, or sign out.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.code_hint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.

sessions.invalid_credentials: That organization, email and password do not match an account.
sessions.expired: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again.
sessions.invalid_code: That code did not work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app, or a backup code.

new.title: Forgot your password?
new.instructions: Enter your organization and email. If they match an account, we send a link to choose a new password.

passwords.reset_requested: If that account exists, we sent password reset instructions to its email address.
passwords.invalid_link: That reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
passwords.changed: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

errors.too_short: New password must be at least %{count} characters
errors.mismatch: Confirmation does not match the password
errors.invalid: New password is not a valid password

show.title: Two-factor authentication
show.disabled: Two-factor authentication is off. Turn it on to require a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.
show.unavailable: Two-factor authentication is not available: FORGE_AUTH_MFA_KEY is not configured.
show.code_hint: From your authenticator app, or one of your backup codes.
show.rotate_hint: Starting a replacement uses up the current code of your authenticator app. To finish, wait for the next code or use a backup code.

new.title: Set up your authenticator app
new.instructions: Add this account to your authenticator app with the link, or type the key into it. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.

backup_codes.title: Your backup codes
backup_codes.instructions: Each code signs you in once when you cannot use your authenticator app. Store them somewhere safe: they are shown only now.
backup_codes.signed_out: You were signed out everywhere. Sign in with your password and a code.

mfa.disabled: Two-factor authentication is off. Sign in again.

errors.step_up: That password or code did not work.
errors.invalid_code: That code did not work. Enter the current code from your authenticator app.
errors.changed: Two-factor authentication changed meanwhile. Check the settings and try again.

sign_in.one: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a minute.
sign_in.other: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in %{count} minutes.

reset.one: Too many reset attempts. Try again in a minute.
reset.other: Too many reset attempts. Try again in %{count} minutes.

code.one: Too many code attempts. Try again in a minute.
code.other: Too many code attempts. Try again in %{count} minutes.
